blocks.prompt: Online research ki qismein aur un ke maqasid misalon ke saath bataiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Aam maloomat ki research khulasa deti hai, maslan renewable energy samajhne ke liye Google par talash. Ilmi research parhai ke liye mahir aur tafseeli maakhaz dhoondti hai, jaise project ke liye aloodgi par journal articles. Market research karobaron ko rujhan, gahak aur muqabla samjhati hai, jaise dukaan naye product ki talab dekhti hai. Fact-checking motabar maakhaz mila kar daawe ki sachai tay karti hai, jaise viral khabar jaanchna. Sehat ki research motabar tibbi sites aur journals se alamaat aur ilaj ki maloomat dhoondti hai.

items: Paanch qismein: aam, ilmi, market, fact-checking, sehat.
